_derived_from: beast.json tools['restylize_views.py'].prompt - stems are that string with whole comma-terms DELETED, never retyped. Term order is the entry's throughout.
_entry_verbatim: a winged dragon, deep moss-green scaled hide, pale bone-tan ventral plates, storm-grey wing membranes, bone-ivory curved horns, bone-ivory crown and cheek spikes, bone-ivory dorsal and tail spines, bone-ivory claws, ember-orange eyes, a dark wine-red tongue, pale ivory fangs and tooth rows, a dark slate mouth interior, plain lavender-grey background, ultra-realistic, menacing, sharp scale relief, harsh directional light
_the_rule: E12 Ruling 9d: an element whose surface a view cannot see is dropped from that view's stem - a term present in a view's prompt is an instruction to paint it, and the text wins against the control (the W3 beard mechanism, measured). Split deviation measured and ruled at E12 Ruling 10i.
_assertions: Each stem asserted an ordered SUBSEQUENCE of the entry's term list; each view with no drops asserted BYTE-EQUAL to the entry. Both enforced in the builder with no skip flag; a failure writes no file.
_supersedes: E12-pair-2 (accd9e3), which was correct in structure but carried the SALTROAD painterly style tail ('visible brushstrokes, painterly worked surface'). E12 Ruling 10b ruled the style register subject data and rewrote the beast's to ultra-realistic with NO LoRA; beast.json's protective prompt entry was corrected in the same fold, and this rebuild re-derives every stem from the corrected entry mechanically. v2 was also hand-built - its claim that 'the builder asserted' the subsequence property had no committed builder behind it; this one does.
_split_provenance: E12 Ruling 9d default (mouth family off the rear-family views; horn family everywhere) with the MEASURED deviation ruled at E12 Ruling 10i: views 3 and 5 hide the whole head behind the near wing membrane, so the horn family drops there too. Verified in the prior session against all eight profile-rendered clay views with the head box drawn (HEADBOX_8.png) plus per-view first-hit measurement (e12_view_visibility.py): head-box first-hit is 0.81% of figure at views 3 and 5 - and that is WING passing through the box's region of space - against 5.35-12.79% on the head-bearing views. Net: mouth family off {3,4,5}, horn family off {3,5}. The ivory colour family is still carried at 3 and 5 by D6 dorsal/tail spines and D7 claws.
_style_tail: ultra-realistic, menacing, sharp scale relief, harsh directional light - the STYLE-SUPPLIED row of canon/DRAGON-IDENTITY.md as rewritten by E12 Ruling 10b. NO LoRA: lora-w 0.0 is not a weight of zero on a loaded card, it is no card, and the graph is built without the loader node.
_backdrop: plain lavender-grey background - RULED, E12 Ruling 8a. Carried in every stem including the reduced ones; it is not an element of the subject and no view lacks a background.
